items.title: Over 85% of Japanese Game Developers Now Use Generative AI
items.excerpt: CESA reports that over 85% of Japanese game developers use generative AI at least occasionally, while studios are prioritizing human review, restricted tools, and policies against using raw outputs unchanged.

items.title: Recreating the Late-'90s Console Shooter Enemy AI for an FPS
items.excerpt: Replicant D6 spoke about the retro FPS Agent 64: Spies Never Die, detailing what he wanted to preserve from the late-'90s shooter games, how he designed the enemies and how they work, and explaining why he prefers readability over intelligence in terms of combat.

items.title: Unity's Official Plugin for Codex: Skills, CLI, Editor Control
